title: 第12章 击杀郑掌班
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
他有早起练功的习惯，在地球坚持了十几年，不管前一天睡得有多晚，第二天依然六点钟准时起床。
起床后陈浩喝了一杯水，便提着绣春刀出了门，在他心里雷打不动的每日苦练要比侠客点更重要，侠客点能升级功法，而磨炼意自身意志力升华的是内心！
“大哥！”
推开门的时候，陈浩发现沈炼站在自己门前，于是打招呼道。
沈炼没有说话，他抬手递给了陈浩一张纸。
陈浩接过纸，只见上面写着“火烧案牍库后，去清风茶楼。”
“他们行动倒是挺迅速，一大早就答应了条件，对咱们火烧案牍库真是迫不及待啊！”
陈浩看完后将纸撕成了碎片，他捧在手心轻轻吹了口气，碎片便迎着微风飘进了旁边的水沟里，接着便被尚未干透的雨水给浸透。
“何时出发？”沈炼问道，他表情很严峻，一夜过后像是做出了什么决定。
“大哥也去吗？”陈浩道。
“当然，这件事是因我而起，我当然不会逃避！”沈炼说道。
陈浩想了想道：“咱们子时动身！”
“好。”沈炼听后点了点头。
商量好了时间，陈浩二人便开始了这几天循环做的事情，练功，吃饭，去明时坊百户所。
这一天过得和以前一样平静，裴纶没来百户所调查沈炼，百户所里也没出什么大案，鸡毛蒜皮的事情倒有几件。
待到放衙时陈浩和沈炼先是去吃了顿饭，然后便回家睡起了觉，等到子时打更声响起，二人便身穿夜行衣开始了今日的计划。
沈炼对京城很熟，所以一直由他在前面带路，约莫半个时辰后二人来到了北镇抚司的案牍库门前。
今天案牍库被东厂的郑掌班下了禁令，任何人不许靠近案牍库，因此诺大的案牍库空无一人，倒也方便了他们二人。
“大哥去烧案牍库，我在这守着观察情况，记得将宝船纪要拿到手！”
陈浩与沈炼对视一眼安排道，沈炼没有多话，转身就进了案牍库，而陈浩隐藏在了一根柱子后面。

原电影中沈炼刚进了案牍库不大会，就被郑掌班给发现了。
而陈浩隐藏起来的目的是击杀郑掌班来获取侠客点。
没办法，想要获取侠客点太难了，必须要达到两点要求，第一恶贯满盈之人，第二要武功不错，必须要将一门外功练到大成，这两者缺一不可，凌云恺和丁泰都在这个层次，而郑掌班的实力显然更高一点，他的流星锤熟练度俨然达到了大成巅峰，距离圆满也不远了。
而且东厂的番子能有几个是好人，更何况是一个权力不小的掌班。
踏！踏！踏！
一道轻微的脚步声传到了陈浩的耳中，他放眼望去，一个黑影小心谨慎的从外面走进了案牍库大院。
“谁？”
走着走着郑掌班突然停下了脚步，一双鹰隼般的眼睛直直的盯住了陈浩的藏身处，尽管陈浩躲藏的很好，但还是被他给发现了。
“淡红色！”
被发现后陈浩不慌不忙的走了出来，他好奇的打量着郑掌班，在他的眼里郑掌班的头顶竟散发着一种浓浓的红气，这让陈浩十分不解，他就是因为惊讶于郑掌班头顶的淡红色，身子微动了一下才被发现的。
“尊敬的宿主，鉴于你将普通外功升级到了‘超神’境界，系统赠送你一套‘望气术’，助你行侠仗义，惩奸除恶。望气术分为九个级别，赤、橙、黄、绿、青、蓝、紫、白、黑，赤色的罪恶值最低，黑色的罪恶值最高，只有恶贯满盈和武力值达标的人才会显示颜色，一般人是没有颜色的，只要头顶出现这种颜色那就是达到标准的恶人。”这时系统提示道。
“有意思！”陈浩轻轻一笑，这下不怕杀错人了。
“你是谁？”见蒙着面的陈浩从石柱后面走出，郑掌班微微退后了两步，右手放在了身后流星锤的铁绳上。
“杀你的人！”陈浩自腰间抽出绣春刀，然后很风骚的说道。
郑掌班眉头一皱道：“锦衣卫，居然会是个小家贼，你想杀咱家？那就让你尝尝咱家的手段！”
说罢郑掌班抓住流星锤的铁链快速的甩了出去，那流星锤就像一颗发射的炮弹急速冲向陈浩。
“力劈华山！”
迎着急速而来的流星锤陈浩使出了一招力劈华山，绣春刀在空中划出一个刀影，重重的劈在流星锤上。

content_en:
He has the habit of getting up early to practice Qigong, and he has persisted for more than ten years on earth. No matter how late he went to bed the day before, he still got up on time at six o'clock the next day.
After getting up, Chen Hao drank a glass of water and went out with the Xiuchun Dao. In his heart, the daily hard training was more important than the knight points. The knight points can upgrade the skills, and it is the heart that refines and sublimates one's own willpower!
"Brother!"
When he opened the door, Chen Hao found Shen Lian standing in front of his door, so he said hello.
Shen Lian didn't say anything. He raised his hand and handed Chen Hao a piece of paper.
Chen Hao took the paper and saw it said, "After burning the case library, go to Qingfeng Tea House."
"They acted very quickly. They agreed to the conditions early in the morning, and they couldn't wait for us to burn the records library!"
After reading it, Chen Hao tore the paper into pieces. He held it in the palm of his hand and blew gently. The pieces floated into the ditch next to the breeze, and then were soaked by the rainwater that had not yet dried.
"When will we set off?" Shen Lian asked. His expression was serious, as if he had made some decision after a night.
"Brother, are you going too?" Chen Hao asked.
"Of course, this happened because of me, and of course I will not run away!" Shen Lian said.
Chen Hao thought for a moment and said, "We'll leave soon!"
"Okay." Shen Lian nodded after hearing this.
After discussing the time, Chen Hao and Chen Hao started doing what they had been doing in a cycle for the past few days, practicing, eating, and going to Mingshifang Baihu Station.
The day passed as peacefully as before. Pei Lun did not come to the Baihu Institute to investigate Shen Lian, and there were no major cases in the Baihu Institute. There were only a few trivial matters.
When it was time to leave the office, Chen Hao and Shen Lian went to have a meal first, and then went home to sleep. When the midnight clock sounded, the two of them put on night clothes and started today's plans.
Shen Lian was very familiar with the capital, so he had been leading the way. About half an hour later, the two of them arrived at the door of Fusi's archives in Beizhen.
Today, the document warehouse was banned by Manager Zheng of the East Factory. No one was allowed to approach the document warehouse. Therefore, the document warehouse in Nuo Da was empty, which was convenient for the two of them.
"Brother is going to burn the case and document treasury. I will stay here to observe the situation. Remember to get the treasure ship minutes!"
Chen Hao and Shen Lian looked at each other and made arrangements. Shen Lian turned around and entered the document library without saying much, while Chen Hao hid behind a pillar.
In the original movie, Shen Lian was discovered by Captain Zheng as soon as he entered the archives.
The purpose of Chen Hao's hiding is to kill Zheng Zhangban to obtain knight points.
There is no way, it is too difficult to obtain knight points. You must meet two requirements. First, you must be a person with a lot of evil, and second, you must be good at martial arts. You must practice an external skill to a great level. Both of them are indispensable. Ling Yunkai and Ding Tai are both at this level, but Zheng Ban's strength is obviously higher. His meteor hammer proficiency has reached the peak of great achievement, and is not far away from perfection.
And how many of Dongchang's fans are good people, let alone a boss with considerable power.
tread! tread! tread!
The sound of slight footsteps reached Chen Hao's ears. He looked around and saw a black figure cautiously walking into the courtyard of the archives from the outside.
"Who?"
As he was walking, Master Zheng suddenly stopped and stared straight at Chen Hao's hiding place with a pair of falcon-like eyes. Although Chen Hao hid well, he was still discovered by him.
"Light red!"
After being discovered, Chen Hao walked out calmly. He looked at Manager Zheng curiously. In his eyes, the head of Manager Zheng's head actually exuded a thick red aura, which puzzled Chen Hao. He was surprised by the light red color on the top of Banner Zheng's head, so he moved slightly before being discovered.
"Dear host, since you have upgraded your ordinary external skills to the realm of 'super god', the system will give you a set of 'Qi-Wang Technique' to help you act chivalrously, punish rape and eliminate evil. The Qi-Wang Technique is divided into nine levels, red, orange, yellow, green, green and blue., purple, white, black, red has the lowest sin value, and black has the highest sin value. Only those who are full of evil and have a strong force value will show the color. Most people have no color. As long as this color appears on the top of their head, they are evil people who have reached the standard. "At this time, the system prompted.
"Interesting! "Chen Hao smiled softly, now he was no longer afraid of killing the wrong person.
"Who are you? "Seeing the masked Chen Hao walking out from behind the stone pillar, Master Zheng took two steps back slightly and placed his right hand on the iron rope of the meteor hammer behind him.
"Kill your people! "Chen Hao took out the Xiuchundao from his waist and said coquettishly.
Commander Zheng frowned and said, "Jinyiwei is actually a little thief. Do you want to kill our family? Then let you try our methods! "
After that, Commander Zheng grabbed the iron chain of the meteor hammer and quickly threw it out. The meteor hammer rushed towards Chen Hao like a fired cannonball.
"Strike Huashan with all your strength!" "
Facing the meteor hammer that was approaching rapidly, Chen Hao used a move to chop Huashan. The Xiuchun knife drew a knife shadow in the air and struck the meteor hammer heavily.
